verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יַפְלִ֖א נֶ֑דֶר בְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ נְפָשֹׁ֖ת לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’îš kî yap̄·li ne·ḏer bə·‘er·kə·ḵā nə·p̄ā·šōṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and say to them When someone makes a special vow to the LORD involving the value of persons

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה עֶרְכְּךָ֙ הַזָּכָ֔ר מִבֶּן֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־ שִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וְהָיָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֗ חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כֶּ֖סֶף בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ‘er·kə·ḵā haz·zā·ḵār mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wə·‘aḏ ben- šiš·šîm šā·nāh wə·hā·yāh ‘er·kə·ḵā ḥă·miš·šîm še·qel ke·sep̄ bə·še·qel haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: if the valuation concerns a male . . . from twenty to . . . sixty years of age then your valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver according to the sanctuary shekel

verses.original: וְאִם־ נְקֵבָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְהָיָ֥ה עֶרְכְּךָ֖ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָֽׁקֶל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- nə·qê·ḇāh hî wə·hā·yāh ‘er·kə·ḵā šə·lō·šîm šā·qel
verses.literal: Or if it is a female then your valuation shall be thirty shekels

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם מִבֶּן־ חָמֵ֜שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים וְעַד֙ בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְהָיָ֧ה עֶרְכְּךָ֛ הַזָּכָ֖ר עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֑ים וְלַנְּקֵבָ֖ה עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת שְׁקָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im mib·ben- ḥā·mêš šā·nîm wə·‘aḏ ben- ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wə·hā·yāh ‘er·kə·ḵā haz·zā·ḵār ‘eś·rîm šə·qā·lîm wə·lan·nə·qê·ḇāh ‘ă·śe·reṯ šə·qā·lîm
verses.literal: And if the person is from five to . . . twenty . . . years of age . . . then your valuation for the male shall be twenty shekels and for the female ten shekels

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם מִבֶּן־ חֹ֗דֶשׁ וְעַד֙ בֶּן־ חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְהָיָ֤ה עֶרְכְּךָ֙ הַזָּכָ֔ר חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּ֑סֶף וְלַנְּקֵבָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֔ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im mib·ben- ḥō·ḏeš wə·‘aḏ ben- ḥā·mêš šā·nîm wə·hā·yāh ‘er·kə·ḵā haz·zā·ḵār ḥă·miš·šāh šə·qā·lîm kā·sep̄ wə·lan·nə·qê·ḇāh ‘er·kə·ḵā šə·lō·šeṯ šə·qā·lîm kā·sep̄
verses.literal: Now if the person is from one month to . . . five years of age then your valuation for the male shall be five shekels of silver and for the female three shekels of silver

verses.original: וְ֠אִם מִבֶּן־ שִׁשִּׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה וָמַ֙עְלָה֙ אִם־ זָכָ֔ר וְהָיָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֔ חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר שָׁ֑קֶל וְלַנְּקֵבָ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֥ה שְׁקָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im mib·ben- šiš·šîm šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh ’im- zā·ḵār wə·hā·yāh ‘er·kə·ḵā ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār šā·qel wə·lan·nə·qê·ḇāh ‘ă·śā·rāh šə·qā·lîm
verses.literal: And if the person is . . . sixty years of age or older . . . then your valuation shall be fifteen . . . shekels for the male and ten shekels for the female

verses.original: וְאִם־ מָ֥ךְ הוּא֙ מֵֽעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְהֶֽעֱמִידוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהֶעֱרִ֥יךְ אֹת֖וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן עַל־ פִּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּשִּׂיג֙ יַ֣ד הַנֹּדֵ֔ר יַעֲרִיכֶ֖נּוּ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- māḵ hū mê·‘er·ke·ḵā wə·he·‘ĕ·mî·ḏōw lip̄·nê hak·kō·hên wə·he·‘ĕ·rîḵ ’ō·ṯōw hak·kō·hên ‘al- pî ’ă·šer taś·śîḡ yaḏ han·nō·ḏêr ya·‘ă·rî·ḵen·nū hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: But if the one making the vow is too poor to pay the valuation he is to present the person before the priest who shall set the value - according to . . . what the one making the vow can afford . . .

verses.original: וְאִם־ בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֧יבוּ מִמֶּ֛נָּה קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן מִמֶּ֛נּוּ לַיהוָ֖ה יִֽהְיֶה־ קֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer yaq·rî·ḇū mim·men·nāh qār·bān Yah·weh kōl ’ă·šer yit·tên mim·men·nū Yah·weh yih·yeh- qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: If he vows an animal that may be brought as an offering to the LORD any such animal given to the LORD shall be holy

verses.original: לֹ֣א יַחֲלִיפֶ֗נּוּ וְלֹֽא־ יָמִ֥יר אֹת֛וֹ ט֥וֹב בְּרָ֖ע אוֹ־ רַ֣ע בְּט֑וֹב וְאִם־ הָמֵ֨ר יָמִ֤יר בְּהֵמָה֙ בִּבְהֵמָ֔ה וְהָֽיָה־ ה֥וּא וּתְמוּרָת֖וֹ יִֽהְיֶה־ קֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lō ya·ḥă·lî·p̄en·nū wə·lō- yā·mîr ’ō·ṯōw ṭō·wḇ bə·rā‘ ’ōw- ra‘ bə·ṭō·wḇ wə·’im- hā·mêr yā·mîr bə·hê·māh biḇ·hê·māh wə·hā·yāh- hū ū·ṯə·mū·rā·ṯōw yih·yeh- qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: He must not replace it . . . or exchange it either good for bad or bad for good But if he does substitute . . . one animal for another both that animal and its substitute . . . will be holy

verses.original: וְאִם֙ כָּל־ בְּהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֔ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא־ יַקְרִ֧יבוּ מִמֶּ֛נָּה קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה וְהֶֽעֱמִ֥יד אֶת־ הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im kāl- bə·hê·māh ṭə·mê·’āh ’ă·šer lō- yaq·rî·ḇū mim·men·nāh qār·bān Yah·weh wə·he·‘ĕ·mîḏ ’eṯ- hab·bə·hê·māh lip̄·nê hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: But if the vow involves any of the unclean animals that may not be brought . . . as an offering to the LORD the animal must be presented before the priest

verses.original: וְהֶעֱרִ֤יךְ הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֹתָ֔הּ בֵּ֥ין ט֖וֹב וּבֵ֣ין רָ֑ע כְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן כֵּ֥ן יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ĕ·rîḵ hak·kō·hên ’ō·ṯāh bên ṭō·wḇ ū·ḇên rā‘ kə·‘er·kə·ḵā hak·kō·hên kên yih·yeh
verses.literal: The priest - shall set its value whether high . . . or low as the priest values it the price will be set

verses.original: וְאִם־ גָּאֹ֖ל יִגְאָלֶ֑נָּה וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִישִׁת֖וֹ עַל־ עֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- gā·’ōl yiḡ·’ā·len·nāh wə·yā·sap̄ ḥă·mî·ši·ṯōw ‘al- ‘er·ke·ḵā
verses.literal: If, however, the owner decides to redeem the animal . . . he must add a fifth to its value

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־ יַקְדִּ֨שׁ אֶת־ בֵּית֥וֹ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְהֶעֱרִיכוֹ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן בֵּ֥ין ט֖וֹב וּבֵ֣ין רָ֑ע כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲרִ֥יךְ אֹת֛וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן כֵּ֥ן יָקֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš kî- yaq·diš ’eṯ- bê·ṯōw qō·ḏeš Yah·weh wə·he·‘ĕ·rî·ḵōw hak·kō·hên bên ṭō·wḇ ū·ḇên rā‘ ka·’ă·šer ya·‘ă·rîḵ ’ō·ṯōw hak·kō·hên kên yā·qūm
verses.literal: Now if a man consecrates his house as holy to the LORD then the priest shall value it either as good or bad The price will stand just as the priest . . . values it

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם־ הַמַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ יִגְאַ֖ל אֶת־ בֵּית֑וֹ וְ֠יָסַף חֲמִישִׁ֧ית כֶּֽסֶף־ עֶרְכְּךָ֛ עָלָ֖יו וְהָ֥יָה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ham·maq·dîš yiḡ·’al ’eṯ- bê·ṯōw wə·yā·sap̄ ḥă·mî·šîṯ ke·sep̄- ‘er·kə·ḵā ‘ā·lāw wə·hā·yāh lōw
verses.literal: But if he who consecrated his house redeems it he must add a fifth to the assessed value and it will belong to him

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם׀ מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֗וֹ יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה עֶרְכְּךָ֖ לְפִ֣י זַרְע֑וֹ זֶ֚רַע חֹ֣מֶר שְׂעֹרִ֔ים בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im miś·śə·ḏêh ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯōw yaq·dîš ’îš Yah·weh wə·hā·yāh ‘er·kə·ḵā lə·p̄î zar·‘ōw ze·ra‘ ḥō·mer śə·‘ō·rîm ba·ḥă·miš·šîm še·qel kā·sep̄
verses.literal: If a man consecrates to the LORD a parcel of his land then your valuation shall be proportional to the seed required for it fifty shekels of silver for every homer of barley seed

verses.original: אִם־ מִשְּׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵ֑הוּ כְּעֶרְכְּךָ֖ יָקֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- miš·šə·naṯ hay·yō·ḇêl yaq·dîš śā·ḏê·hū kə·‘er·kə·ḵā yā·qūm
verses.literal: If he consecrates his field during the Year of Jubilee the price will stand according to your valuation

verses.original: וְאִם־ אַחַ֣ר הַיֹּבֵל֮ יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ֒ וְחִשַּׁב־ ל֨וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ הַכֶּ֗סֶף עַל־ פִּ֤י הַשָּׁנִים֙ הַנּ֣וֹתָרֹ֔ת עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְנִגְרַ֖ע מֵֽעֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’a·ḥar hay·yō·ḇêl yaq·dîš śā·ḏê·hū wə·ḥiš·šaḇ- lōw hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ ‘al- pî haš·šā·nîm han·nō·w·ṯā·rōṯ ‘aḏ šə·naṯ hay·yō·ḇêl wə·niḡ·ra‘ mê·‘er·ke·ḵā
verses.literal: But if he consecrates his field after the Jubilee the priest is to calculate the price in proportion to . . . the years left until the next Year of Jubilee so that your valuation will be reduced

verses.original: וְאִם־ גָּאֹ֤ל יִגְאַל֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה הַמַּקְדִּ֖ישׁ אֹת֑וֹ וְ֠יָסַף חֲמִשִׁ֧ית כֶּֽסֶף־ עֶרְכְּךָ֛ עָלָ֖יו וְקָ֥ם לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- gā·’ōl yiḡ·’al ’eṯ- haś·śā·ḏeh ham·maq·dîš ’ō·ṯōw wə·yā·sap̄ ḥă·mi·šîṯ ke·sep̄- ‘er·kə·ḵā ‘ā·lāw wə·qām lōw
verses.literal: And if the one who consecrated the field decides to redeem it . . . he must add a fifth to the assessed value and it shall belong to him

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֤א יִגְאַל֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וְאִם־ מָכַ֥ר אֶת־ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה לְאִ֣ישׁ אַחֵ֑ר לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō yiḡ·’al ’eṯ- haś·śā·ḏeh wə·’im- mā·ḵar ’eṯ- haś·śā·ḏeh lə·’îš ’a·ḥêr lō yig·gā·’êl ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: If, however he does not redeem the field or if he has sold it to another man it may no longer be redeemed

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה בְּצֵאת֣וֹ בַיֹּבֵ֗ל קֹ֛דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָ֖ה כִּשְׂדֵ֣ה הַחֵ֑רֶם לַכֹּהֵ֖ן תִּהְיֶ֥ה אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh haś·śā·ḏeh bə·ṣê·ṯōw ḇay·yō·ḇêl qō·ḏeš Yah·weh kiś·ḏêh ha·ḥê·rem lak·kō·hên tih·yeh ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯōw
verses.literal: When the field is released in the Jubilee it will become holy like a field devoted to the LORD it becomes the property of the priests

verses.original: וְאִם֙ אֶת־ שְׂדֵ֣ה מִקְנָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֕ר לֹ֖א מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֑וֹ יַקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im ’eṯ- śə·ḏêh miq·nā·ṯōw ’ă·šer lō miś·śə·ḏêh ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯōw yaq·dîš Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now if a man consecrates to the LORD a field he has purchased which is not a part of his own property

verses.original: וְחִשַּׁב־ ל֣וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֵ֚ת מִכְסַ֣ת הָֽעֶרְכְּךָ֔ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְנָתַ֤ן אֶת־ הָעֶרְכְּךָ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥiš·šaḇ- lōw hak·kō·hên ’êṯ miḵ·saṯ hā·‘er·kə·ḵā ‘aḏ šə·naṯ hay·yō·ḇêl wə·nā·ṯan ’eṯ- hā·‘er·kə·ḵā bay·yō·wm ha·hū qō·ḏeš Yah·weh
verses.literal: then the priest shall calculate for him the value . . . up to the Year of Jubilee and the man shall pay the assessed value on that day as a sacred offering to the LORD

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת הַיּוֹבֵל֙ יָשׁ֣וּב הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר קָנָ֖הוּ מֵאִתּ֑וֹ לַאֲשֶׁר־ ל֖וֹ אֲחֻזַּ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ hay·yō·w·ḇêl yā·šūḇ haś·śā·ḏeh la·’ă·šer qā·nā·hū mê·’it·tōw la·’ă·šer- lōw ’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to the one from whom it was bought . . . - the original owner of the land

verses.original: וְכָל־ עֶרְכְּךָ֔ יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה הַשָּֽׁקֶל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ‘er·kə·ḵā yih·yeh bə·še·qel haq·qō·ḏeš ‘eś·rîm gê·rāh yih·yeh haš·šā·qel
verses.literal: Every valuation will be according to the sanctuary shekel twenty gerahs . . . to the shekel

verses.original: אַךְ־ בְּכ֞וֹר אֲשֶׁר־ יְבֻכַּ֤ר לַֽיהוָה֙ בִּבְהֵמָ֔ה לֹֽא־ יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ אֹת֑וֹ אִם־ שׁ֣וֹר אִם־ שֶׂ֔ה לַֽיהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- bə·ḵō·wr ’ă·šer- yə·ḇuk·kar Yah·weh biḇ·hê·māh lō- yaq·dîš ’îš ’ō·ṯōw ’im- šō·wr ’im- śeh Yah·weh hū
verses.literal: But no one may consecrate a firstborn of the livestock because a firstborn belongs to the LORD Whether it is an ox or a sheep it is the LORD’s

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם בַּבְּהֵמָ֤ה הַטְּמֵאָה֙ וּפָדָ֣ה בְעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִשִׁת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְאִם־ לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל וְנִמְכַּ֥ר בְּעֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im bab·bə·hê·māh haṭ·ṭə·mê·’āh ū·p̄ā·ḏāh ḇə·‘er·ke·ḵā wə·yā·sap̄ ḥă·mi·ši·ṯōw ‘ā·lāw wə·’im- lō yig·gā·’êl wə·nim·kar bə·‘er·ke·ḵā
verses.literal: But if it is among the unclean animals then he may redeem it according to your valuation and add a fifth of its value If it is not redeemed then it shall be sold according to your valuation

verses.original: אַךְ־ כָּל־ חֵ֡רֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַחֲרִם֩ אִ֨ישׁ לַֽיהוָ֜ה מִכָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֗וֹ מֵאָדָ֤ם וּבְהֵמָה֙ וּמִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֔וֹ לֹ֥א יִמָּכֵ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יִגָּאֵ֑ל כָּל־ חֵ֕רֶם קֹֽדֶשׁ־ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- kāl- ḥê·rem ’ă·šer ya·ḥă·rim ’îš Yah·weh mik·kāl ’ă·šer- lōw mê·’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh ū·miś·śə·ḏêh ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯōw lō yim·mā·ḵêr wə·lō yig·gā·’êl kāl- ḥê·rem qō·ḏeš- qā·ḏā·šîm hū Yah·weh
verses.literal: Nothing that a man sets apart . . . to the LORD from all he owns whether a man an animal or his inherited land . . . can be sold . . . or redeemed everything so devoted is most holy . . . to the LORD

verses.original: כָּל־ חֵ֗רֶם אֲשֶׁ֧ר יָחֳרַ֛ם מִן־ הָאָדָ֖ם לֹ֣א יִפָּדֶ֑ה מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ḥê·rem ’ă·šer yā·ḥo·ram min- hā·’ā·ḏām lō yip·pā·ḏeh mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: No . . . - person set apart for destruction . . . may be ransomed he must surely be put to death . . .

verses.original: וְכָל־ מַעְשַׂ֨ר הָאָ֜רֶץ מִזֶּ֤רַע הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ מִפְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ לַיהוָ֖ה ה֑וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ma‘·śar hā·’ā·reṣ miz·ze·ra‘ hā·’ā·reṣ mip·pə·rî hā·‘êṣ Yah·weh hū qō·ḏeš Yah·weh
verses.literal: Thus any tithe from the land whether from the seed of the land or the fruit of the trees belongs to the LORD it is holy to the LORD

verses.original: וְאִם־ גָּאֹ֥ל יִגְאַ֛ל אִ֖ישׁ מִמַּֽעַשְׂר֑וֹ חֲמִשִׁית֖וֹ יֹסֵ֥ף עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- gā·’ōl yiḡ·’al ’îš mim·ma·‘aś·rōw ḥă·mi·šî·ṯōw yō·sêp̄ ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: If a man wishes to redeem part of his tithe he must add a fifth to its value

verses.original: וְכָל־ מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָצֹ֔אן כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲבֹ֖ר תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑בֶט הָֽעֲשִׂירִ֕י יִֽהְיֶה־ קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ma‘·śar bā·qār wā·ṣōn kōl ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·ḇōr ta·ḥaṯ haš·šā·ḇeṭ hā·‘ă·śî·rî yih·yeh- qō·ḏeš Yah·weh
verses.literal: Every tenth animal from the herd or flock . . . that passes under the shepherd’s rod . . . will be holy to the LORD

verses.original: לֹ֧א יְבַקֵּ֛ר בֵּֽין־ ט֥וֹב לָרַ֖ע וְלֹ֣א יְמִירֶ֑נּוּ וְאִם־ הָמֵ֣ר יְמִירֶ֔נּוּ וְהָֽיָה־ ה֧וּא וּתְמוּרָת֛וֹ יִֽהְיֶה־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lō yə·ḇaq·qêr bên- ṭō·wḇ lā·ra‘ wə·lō yə·mî·ren·nū wə·’im- hā·mêr yə·mî·ren·nū wə·hā·yāh- hū ū·ṯə·mū·rā·ṯōw yih·yeh- qō·ḏeš lō yig·gā·’êl
verses.literal: He must not inspect whether it is good or bad and he shall not make any substitution But if he does make a substitution . . . both the animal and its substitute . . . shall become holy they cannot be redeemed

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַמִּצְוֺ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּהַ֖ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ham·miṣ·wōṯ ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·har sî·nāy
verses.literal: These are the commandments that the LORD gave to Moses for the Israelites . . . on Mount Sinai
